name: iostream
description: The <iostream> library provides objects which can read user input and output data to the console or to a file.

cin.desc: An input stream to read data from standard input (keyboard).

cout.desc: An output stream to write data to standard output (console).

cerr.desc: An output stream for error messages.

clog.desc: An output stream to log program information.

getline.desc: Reads a line of text from the input stream into a string.

get.desc: Reads a single character from the input stream.

ignore.desc: Ignores characters in the input stream up to a limit or until a delimiter.

read.desc: Reads a block of characters from the input stream.

peek.desc: Returns the next character without extracting it.

eof.desc: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

put.desc: Writes a single character to the output stream.

write.desc: Writes a block of characters to the output stream.

flush.desc: Flushes the output buffer to the output device.
